01 / Mobile

Why Flutter made sense for a school scheduling product.

Technology choice is not about following trends. For a school scheduling system, the important thing is a consistent experience for operators and teachers across devices.

The practical take

Good technical decisions only matter when they make the product easier to use, maintain, and improve. The right answer is usually the one that removes the most friction for the people who depend on the system every day.

  1. One codebase helps features move faster.
  2. A consistent UI reduces the user learning curve.
  3. Native integration is still used where hardware requires it.

That is the standard we use: understand the real context first, then choose the smallest reliable system that moves the work forward.
